summary: Roboticist specialising in event-based vision, robotic localisation, and open-source research software. Research Fellow at the QUT Centre for Robotics, working on vision-based positioning for Roo-ver, Australia’s first lunar rover. Developer of EventCV, with research spanning embedded neuromorphic localisation, event-based place recognition, and reproducible evaluation workflows.

teaching: Primary supervisor for final-year engineering capstone students in QUT’s EGH4001/2 courses, including project direction, mentorship, and assessment.
Co-supervision of visiting PhD students, including work published at the IEEE Neuro Inspired Computational Elements conference.
Designed and delivered a programming workshop for Master of Neuroscience students at the University of Queensland; the workshop was renewed for a second year.
Completed Harvard Business School Online’s Leadership Principles course in 2024.
